data.name: Dark Ride: The Feline Fix
data.detailed_description:
Dark Ride: The Feline Fix is a small, self-contained VR experience set inside an atmospheric potion shop. It’s a relaxed scavenger hunt where you interact with objects, search for ingredients, and piece together a cure for a curious village-wide transformation.

It’s great for families and encourages relaxed exploration and hands-on discovery. The cozy, detailed shop is made for players of all ages to poke around at their own pace, encouraging curiosity and shared moments. With gentle progression and tactile interactions, it’s the kind of game that invites everyone to play together.

Whether you're new to VR, want to get your kids involved, or just looking for something low-key, The Feline Fix offers a calm space to explore and experiment.

Key Features:

  • A Magical Potion Shop: Explore a small but richly detailed Asian-inspired apothecary, filled with interactive objects, hidden surprises, and hand-crafted charm.

  • Scavenger Hunt Gameplay: Search drawers, inspect jars, and follow clues to gather ingredients for the ultimate feline-fixing potion.

  • Built for All Ages: Intuitive, relaxing gameplay makes this the perfect first VR experience for families, kids, and casual players.

  • Vibe-Driven Design: No stress or pressure. It’s just you, the cats, and a magical space designed to reward curiosity.

data.short_description: The Feline Fix is the first cozy adventure in the Dark Ride universe. Step into a magical potion shop tucked within the park and help reverse a curious curse that has turned an entire village into cats! It’s a relaxing scavenger hunt filled with charm, curiosity, and feline mischief.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • VR Support: Uses OpenXR. Requires a VR headset (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Vive Pro, Oculus Rift, Windows Mixed Reality, and other OpenXR-compatible devices).
  • Additional Notes: For best performance, use with a high-refresh-rate headset and a powerful GPU
